records.literal_gloss: And I will strike [the] inhabitants of the city this, both the human and the beast; by pestilence great they will die.

en.L: And I will strike the inhabitants of this city, both human and beast; they will die of a great pestilence.
en.B: I will strike down those who live in this city, people and animals alike; they will die of a terrible plague.
en.R: I will strike down everyone who lives in this city, both people and animals. They will die from a terrible disease.

es.L: Y heriré a los habitantes de esta ciudad, tanto a los hombres como a las bestias; morirán de una gran peste.
es.B: Heriré de muerte a los que viven en esta ciudad, a la gente y a los animales por igual; morirán de una peste terrible.
es.R: Heriré de muerte a todos los que viven en esta ciudad, tanto a la gente como a los animales. Morirán de una enfermedad terrible.

fr.L: Et je frapperai les habitants de cette ville, les humains et les bêtes ; ils mourront d’une grande peste.
fr.B: Je frapperai ceux qui habitent cette ville, les gens comme les bêtes ; ils mourront d’une peste terrible.
fr.R: Je frapperai tous les habitants de cette ville, les gens comme les animaux. Ils mourront d’une maladie terrible.

sw.L: Nami nitawapiga wakazi wa mji huu, wanadamu na wanyama pia; watakufa kwa tauni kubwa.
sw.B: Nitawaua wale wanaoishi katika mji huu, watu na wanyama pia; watakufa kwa tauni ya kutisha.
sw.R: Nitamuua kila mtu anayeishi katika mji huu, watu na wanyama pia. Watakufa kwa ugonjwa wa kutisha.

vi.L: Ta sẽ đánh cư dân thành này, cả người lẫn thú vật; chúng sẽ chết vì ôn dịch lớn.
vi.B: Ta sẽ đánh phạt dân cư thành này, cả người lẫn thú vật; chúng sẽ chết vì dịch bệnh khủng khiếp.
vi.R: Ta sẽ đánh phạt mọi người sống trong thành này, cả người lẫn thú vật. Chúng sẽ chết vì một bệnh dịch khủng khiếp.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 이 성의 주민들을 사람이든 짐승이든 치겠다. 그들이 큰 전염병으로 죽을 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 이 성에 사는 것들을 사람이든 짐승이든 모두 치겠다. 그들은 무서운 전염병으로 죽을 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 이 성에 사는 사람과 짐승을 모두 치겠다. 그들은 무서운 병에 걸려 죽을 것이다.

pt.L: E ferirei os habitantes desta cidade, tanto o ser humano como o animal; de uma grande peste eles morrerão.
pt.B: Vou ferir de morte os moradores desta cidade, pessoas e animais; eles morrerão de uma peste terrível.
pt.R: Vou matar todos os que moram nesta cidade, tanto as pessoas como os animais. Eles vão morrer de uma doença terrível.

decisions.choice: a great pestilence: a deadly epidemic
decisions.reason: The word means a plague that kills many. In a besieged city, crowded and starving, disease spread fast among people and animals alike.

decisions.choice: human and beast: the whole life of the city
decisions.reason: The pair takes in everyone and everything living in the city, the people and the animals kept inside the walls during the siege (7:20).

decisions.choice: plague (B); disease (R)
decisions.reason: The words settled for Jeremiah: "pestilence" at Literal, "plague" at Balanced, "disease" at Readable.

source.text: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֣ן נְאֻם־יְהוָ֡ה אֶתֵּ֣ן אֶת־צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֣ה וְאֶת־עֲבָדָ֣יו׀וְאֶת־הָעָ֡ם וְאֶת־הַנִּשְׁאָרִים֩ בָּעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֜את מִן־הַדֶּ֣בֶר׀מִן־הַחֶ֣רֶב וּמִן־הָרָעָ֗ב בְּיַד֙ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֔ל וּבְיַד֙ אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֔ם וּבְיַ֖ד מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְהִכָּ֣ם לְפִי־חֶ֔רֶב לֹֽא־יָח֣וּס עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א יַחְמֹ֖ל וְלֹ֥א יְרַחֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And after thus, declaration of Yahweh, I will give Zedekiah king of Judah and his servants and the people and the [ones] remaining in the city this from the pestilence, from the sword and from the famine, into [the] hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and into [the] hand of their enemies and into [the] hand of [those] seeking their life; and he will strike them to [the] mouth of [the] sword; not he will pity on them, and not he will spare, and not he will have compassion.

en.L: And afterward, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, I will give Zedekiah king of Judah and his servants and the people, those who are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and into the hand of their enemies and into the hand of those who seek their life; and he will strike them with the edge of the sword; he will not pity them, and he will not spare [them], and he will not have compassion.'"
en.B: Afterward, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, I will hand over King Zedekiah of Judah, his officials and the people, all in this city who survive the plague, the sword and the famine, to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, to their enemies, to those who want them dead. He will put them to the sword; he will show them no pity, no mercy and no compassion.'"
en.R: After that, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, I will hand over King Zedekiah of Judah, his officials and the people of this city who are still alive after the disease, the war and the famine. I will hand them over to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and to their enemies, who want to kill them. He will kill them with the sword. He will not show them any mercy, pity or kindness.'"

es.L: Y después de esto, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, entregaré a Sedequías, rey de Judá, y a sus siervos y al pueblo, a los que queden en esta ciudad de la peste, de la espada y del hambre, en mano de Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia, y en mano de sus enemigos y en mano de los que buscan su vida; y él los herirá a filo de espada; no les tendrá lástima, ni [los] perdonará, ni tendrá compasión”».
es.B: Después, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, entregaré a Sedequías, rey de Judá, a sus funcionarios y al pueblo, a todos los de esta ciudad que sobrevivan a la peste, a la espada y al hambre, en manos de Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia, en manos de sus enemigos y de los que quieren matarlos. Él los pasará a espada; no les tendrá lástima, ni misericordia, ni compasión”».
es.R: Después de eso, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, entregaré a Sedequías, rey de Judá, a sus funcionarios y a la gente de esta ciudad que siga con vida después de las enfermedades, la guerra y el hambre. Los entregaré en manos de Nabucodorosor, rey de Babilonia, y de sus enemigos, que quieren matarlos. Él los matará a espada. No les tendrá ninguna misericordia, ni lástima, ni bondad”».

fr.L: Et après cela, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je livrerai Sédécias, roi de Juda, et ses serviteurs et le peuple, ceux qui resteront dans cette ville après la peste, l’épée et la famine, entre les mains de Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, et entre les mains de leurs ennemis et entre les mains de ceux qui en veulent à leur vie ; et il les frappera du tranchant de l’épée ; il n’aura pas pitié d’eux, il ne [les] épargnera pas, et il n’aura pas de compassion.” »
fr.B: Ensuite, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je livrerai Sédécias, roi de Juda, ses hauts fonctionnaires et le peuple, tous ceux qui dans cette ville auront survécu à la peste, à l’épée et à la famine, à Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, à leurs ennemis, à ceux qui veulent leur mort. Il les passera au fil de l’épée ; il n’aura pour eux ni pitié, ni indulgence, ni compassion.” »
fr.R: Après cela, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je livrerai Sédécias, le roi de Juda, ses hauts fonctionnaires et les gens de cette ville qui seront encore vivants après la maladie, la guerre et la famine. Je les livrerai à Nabuchodonosor, le roi de Babylone, et à leurs ennemis, qui veulent les tuer. Il les tuera par l’épée. Il n’aura pour eux aucune pitié, aucune indulgence, aucune bonté.” »

sw.L: Na baadaye, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitamtoa Sedekia mfalme wa Yuda, na watumishi wake, na watu, wale waliobaki katika mji huu baada ya tauni, na upanga, na njaa, mkononi mwa Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli, na mkononi mwa adui zao, na mkononi mwa wale wanaotafuta uhai wao; naye atawapiga kwa makali ya upanga; hatawahurumia, wala hatawaachilia, wala hatawaonea huruma.'"
sw.B: Baadaye, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitamtoa Mfalme Sedekia wa Yuda, maafisa wake na watu, wote katika mji huu watakaosalimika baada ya tauni, upanga na njaa, nitawatia mikononi mwa Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli, mikononi mwa adui zao, mikononi mwa wale wanaotaka wafe. Atawaua kwa upanga; hatawaonea huruma, wala hatawaachilia, wala hatawahurumia.'"
sw.R: Baada ya hayo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitamtoa Mfalme Sedekia wa Yuda, maafisa wake, na watu wa mji huu ambao bado watakuwa hai baada ya magonjwa, vita na njaa. Nitawatia mikononi mwa Nebukadreza mfalme wa Babeli na mikononi mwa adui zao, wanaotaka kuwaua. Atawaua kwa upanga. Hatawaonea huruma wala rehema wala wema wowote.'"

vi.L: Sau đó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phó Sê-đê-kia vua Giu-đa, các đầy tớ vua và dân chúng, những người còn sót lại trong thành này sau ôn dịch, gươm và nạn đói, vào tay Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn, vào tay kẻ thù chúng và vào tay những kẻ tìm hại mạng sống chúng; vua ấy sẽ dùng lưỡi gươm đánh chúng; vua sẽ không thương xót, không tha [chúng], cũng không động lòng trắc ẩn.'"
vi.B: Sau đó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phó vua Giu-đa là Sê-đê-kia, các quần thần vua và dân chúng, tức là mọi người trong thành này còn sống sót sau dịch bệnh, gươm đao và nạn đói, vào tay Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn, vào tay kẻ thù và những kẻ muốn giết chúng. Vua ấy sẽ dùng gươm giết chúng; vua sẽ không thương xót, không tha thứ, không chút động lòng.'"
vi.R: Sau đó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phó vua Giu-đa là Sê-đê-kia, các quan chức của vua và những người dân trong thành này còn sống sót sau bệnh tật, chiến tranh và nạn đói. Ta sẽ phó chúng vào tay Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn và vào tay kẻ thù muốn giết chúng. Vua ấy sẽ dùng gươm giết chúng. Vua sẽ không thương xót, không tha thứ, không tỏ chút lòng tốt nào.'"

ko.L: 그 뒤에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다, 내가 유다 왕 시드기야와 그의 신하들과 백성, 곧 이 성에서 전염병과 칼과 기근을 면하고 남은 자들을 바빌론 왕 느부갓레살의 손과 그들의 원수들의 손과 그들의 목숨을 노리는 자들의 손에 넘겨주겠다. 그는 칼날로 그들을 칠 것이다. 그는 그들을 불쌍히 여기지 않고, 아끼지 않고, 긍휼히 여기지도 않을 것이다.'"
ko.B: 그 뒤에 내가 유다 왕 시드기야와 그의 신하들과 백성, 곧 이 성에서 전염병과 칼과 기근을 피하여 살아남은 사람들을 바빌론 왕 느부갓레살과 그들의 원수들, 그들의 목숨을 노리는 자들에게 넘겨주겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그는 그들을 칼로 쳐 죽일 것이다. 그는 그들을 불쌍히 여기지도 아끼지도 긍휼히 여기지도 않을 것이다.'"
ko.R: 그 뒤에 내가 유다 왕 시드기야와 그의 신하들과 이 성의 백성 가운데 질병과 전쟁과 굶주림에서 살아남은 사람들을 넘겨주겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내가 그들을 바빌론 왕 느부갓레살에게, 그리고 그들을 죽이려는 원수들에게 넘겨주겠다. 그는 칼로 그들을 죽일 것이다. 그는 그들에게 조금도 자비나 동정이나 친절을 베풀지 않을 것이다.'"

pt.L: E depois disso, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, entregarei Zedequias, rei de Judá, e os seus servos, e o povo, os que restarem nesta cidade da peste, da espada e da fome, na mão de Nabucodorosor, rei da Babilônia, e na mão dos seus inimigos, e na mão dos que buscam a vida deles; e ele os ferirá a fio de espada; não terá dó deles, e não [os] poupará, e não terá compaixão.'"
pt.B: Depois disso, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, entregarei o rei Zedequias, de Judá, os seus oficiais e o povo, todos os desta cidade que sobreviverem à peste, à espada e à fome, a Nabucodorosor, rei da Babilônia, aos inimigos deles, aos que os querem mortos. Ele os passará a fio de espada; não terá dó, nem piedade, nem compaixão deles.'"
pt.R: Depois disso, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, vou entregar o rei Zedequias, de Judá, os seus oficiais e o povo desta cidade que ainda estiver vivo depois da doença, da guerra e da fome. Vou entregar todos eles a Nabucodorosor, rei da Babilônia, e aos inimigos deles, que querem matá-los. Ele vai matá-los à espada. Não vai ter dó, nem pena, nem bondade com eles.'"

decisions.choice: the people, those who are left: one group, the people who survive the siege
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "and" before both "the people" and "those who are left". The second phrase is taken as saying which people are meant: those still alive when the disease, the war and the famine have done their work.

decisions.choice: those who seek their life: those who want to kill them
decisions.reason: To seek someone's life (literally "soul") is to try to kill them (11:21; 19:7; 1 Kings 19:10).

decisions.choice: the mouth of the sword: its edge
decisions.reason: A sword is said to "eat", so its edge is its "mouth". To strike with the mouth of the sword is to kill without sparing.

decisions.choice: no pity: the fall of the city as it happened
decisions.reason: Three verbs for mercy are each denied. When the city fell, Zedekiah's sons and the nobles of Judah were killed before his eyes, and he was blinded and taken to Babylon (39:5-7; 52:9-11).

decisions.choice: pestilence, sword, famine (L); plague, sword, famine (B); disease, war, famine (R)
decisions.reason: The three disasters keep the wording settled for Jeremiah, in the order this verse gives them.

decisions.choice: his officials
decisions.reason: The king's "servants" are his court officials; Literal keeps "servants".

decisions.choice: la peste, la espada, el hambre (Literal, Balanced); las enfermedades, la guerra, el hambre (Readable)
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's triad keeps one Spanish wording at each level through the block, as the terms note sets (2 Chronicles 20:9).

decisions.choice: a filo de espada
decisions.reason: The "mouth of the sword" is its edge (meaning decision m3); Spanish says "a filo de espada".

decisions.choice: tauni, upanga, njaa (Literal, Balanced); magonjwa, vita, njaa (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled Swahili for Jeremiah's triad (2 Samuel 24:13 for "tauni"), in the order of this verse.

decisions.choice: "la peste, l'épée et la famine" (L, B); "la maladie, la guerre et la famine" (R)
alternatives: la guerre, la faim et la peste
decisions.reason: The three disasters as the terms note sets them for Jeremiah, in the order this verse gives them.

decisions.choice: "ôn dịch, gươm và nạn đói" / "dịch bệnh, gươm đao và nạn đói" / "bệnh tật, chiến tranh và nạn đói"
decisions.reason: The terms note's words for Jeremiah's triad, kept the same at each level in every list of these chapters, in the order the Hebrew gives.

decisions.choice: "전염병과 칼과 기근" (L, B); "질병과 전쟁과 굶주림" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's set for Jeremiah's triad (sword, famine and plague; war, famine and disease at Readable), in the order the Hebrew lists them here.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다" after the first clause
decisions.reason: A Korean sentence cannot be broken after its time phrase as the Hebrew is; Literal sets the formula off between commas, and Balanced and Readable close the first sentence and set it after.

decisions.choice: a espada, a fome e a peste (L, B); a guerra, a fome e a doença (R)
decisions.reason: The three disasters keep the wording 5:12 sets for the whole book (r-pt-1 there) at each level wherever they return (verses 6 and 9; 14:12; 24:10; 27:8; 29:17-18 and after), in the order each verse gives them, as the English does. "A peste" at Literal and Balanced is the Portuguese word for a deadly epidemic (m1 of verse 6); Readable says "a doença", and "a guerra" for the sword, as the English Readable says "disease" and "war".

source.text: וְאֶל־הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ תֹּאמַ֔ר כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הִנְנִ֤י נֹתֵן֙ לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם אֶת־דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַחַיִּ֖ים וְאֶת־דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַמָּֽוֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: And to the people this you will say: Thus says Yahweh: Look I [am] setting before you the way of the life and the way of the death.

en.L: "And to this people you shall say, 'Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: Look, I am setting before you the way of life and the way of death.
en.B: "And say to this people, '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: Look, I am putting in front of you the way that leads to life and the way that leads to death.
en.R: "Tell the people of this city, 'This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: I am giving you a choice. One way leads to life, and the other way leads to death.

es.L: «Y a este pueblo dirás: “Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: He aquí, pongo delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} el camino de la vida y el camino de la muerte.
es.B: «Y dile a este pueblo: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Pongo delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} el camino que lleva a la vida y el camino que lleva a la muerte.
es.R: «Diles a los habitantes de esta ciudad: “Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} doy a elegir. Un camino lleva a la vida y el otro lleva a la muerte.

fr.L: « Et à ce peuple tu diras : “Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Voici, je mets devant vous le chemin de la vie et le chemin de la mort.
fr.B: « Et dis à ce peuple : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Je mets devant vous le chemin qui mène à la vie et le chemin qui mène à la mort.
fr.R: « Dis aux gens de cette ville : “Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Je vous donne le choix. Un chemin mène à la vie, et l’autre chemin mène à la mort.

sw.L: "Na watu hawa utawaambia, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Tazama, ninaweka mbele yenu njia ya uzima na njia ya mauti.
sw.B: "Na uwaambie watu hawa, 'Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Tazama, ninaweka mbele yenu njia inayoongoza kwenye uzima na njia inayoongoza kwenye kifo.
sw.R: "Waambie watu wa mji huu, 'Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Ninawapa nafasi ya kuchagua. Njia moja inaongoza kwenye uzima, na njia nyingine inaongoza kwenye kifo.

vi.L: "Ngươi cũng hãy nói với dân này: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đặt trước mặt các ngươi con đường sự sống và con đường sự chết.
vi.B: "Con cũng hãy nói với dân này: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đặt trước mặt các ngươi con đường dẫn đến sự sống và con đường dẫn đến sự chết.
vi.R: "Con hãy nói với dân thành này: 'Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Ta cho các ngươi chọn lựa. Một con đường dẫn đến sự sống, còn con đường kia dẫn đến sự chết.

ko.L: "그리고 너는 이 백성에게 말하여라. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 보아라, 내가 너희 앞에 생명의 길과 죽음의 길을 둔다.
ko.B: "그리고 이 백성에게 말하여라. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 보아라, 내가 너희 앞에 생명으로 가는 길과 죽음으로 가는 길을 내놓는다.
ko.R: "이 성 백성에게 전하여라. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 내가 너희에게 선택할 길을 주겠다. 한 길은 생명으로 가는 길이고, 다른 길은 죽음으로 가는 길이다.

pt.L: "E a este povo dirás: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Eis que eu ponho diante de vocês o caminho da vida e o caminho da morte.
pt.B: "E dize a este povo: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Vejam, ponho diante de vocês o caminho que leva à vida e o caminho que leva à morte.
pt.R: "Dize ao povo desta cidade: 'É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: Eu estou dando a vocês uma escolha. Um caminho leva à vida, e o outro leva à morte.

decisions.choice: the LORD now speaks to Jeremiah himself; verses 8-10 are a message for the people
decisions.reason: The verb "you shall say" is singular: the LORD is telling Jeremiah what to say. Jeremiah's answer to the king's messengers ended with verse 7. This word is for the whole people of the city.

decisions.choice: the way of life and the way of death: an echo of Moses' choice in Deuteronomy 30:15, 19
decisions.reason: Moses set before Israel life and death, and the choice was to love the LORD and keep his commands. Here the same choice is put to a city under siege, but the way of life now means giving up to the enemy (verse 9). The covenant's warnings have come true, and only those who accept the judgment will survive it.

decisions.choice: way: a path, a course of action that leads somewhere
decisions.reason: Each way is named by where it ends: one road ends in life, the other in death.

decisions.choice: I am giving you a choice
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that two ways set before someone are a choice.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다" (L); "... 이렇게 말씀하신다" (B); "... 하시는 말씀이다" (R), with the honorific, though the formula stands inside God's words to Jeremiah
alternatives: "주가 이와 같이 말한다" (God naming himself plainly)
decisions.reason: One rule for Isaiah, Jeremiah and Ezra: the messenger formula keeps the honorific even where God dictates the message, as published at 1 Kings 21:19, 2 Samuel 7:5 and 1 Chronicles 17:4; God's own words that follow stay in the plain style, without -시- for himself.

decisions.choice: dirás, dize (God to Jeremiah); vocês (the people)
decisions.reason: The verb is singular (m1): the LORD now speaks to Jeremiah, so "tu", while the message itself speaks to the people with "vocês".

source.text: הַיֹּשֵׁב֙ בָּעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את יָמ֕וּת בַּחֶ֖רֶב וּבָרָעָ֣ב וּבַדָּ֑בֶר וְהַיּוֹצֵא֩ וְנָפַ֨ל עַל־הַכַּשְׂדִּ֜ים הַצָּרִ֤ים עֲלֵיכֶם֙ וְחָיָ֔ה וְהָֽיְתָה־לּ֥וֹ נַפְשׁ֖וֹ לְשָׁלָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: The [one] staying in the city this will die by the sword and by the famine and by the pestilence; but the [one] going out and falling to the Chaldeans, the [ones] besieging you, will live, and will be to him his life for plunder.

en.L: Whoever stays in this city will die by the sword and by the famine and by the pestilence; but whoever goes out and falls away to the Chaldeans who are besieging you will live, and his life will be his as plunder.
en.B: Those who stay in this city will die by sword, famine and plague. But those who go out and surrender to the Chaldeans who are besieging you will live; they will come away with their lives as their only plunder.
en.R: Anyone who stays in this city will die from war, famine or disease. But anyone who goes out and surrenders to the Babylonians who are attacking you will live. They will escape with their lives, and that will be all they get.

es.L: El que se quede en esta ciudad morirá por la espada, por el hambre y por la peste; pero el que salga y se pase a los caldeos que {{plural_you:los|os}} sitian, vivirá, y tendrá su vida por botín.
es.B: Los que se queden en esta ciudad morirán por la espada, el hambre y la peste. Pero los que salgan y se rindan a los caldeos que {{plural_you:los|os}} sitian vivirán; escaparán con vida como único botín.
es.R: Cualquiera que se quede en esta ciudad morirá en la guerra, de hambre o de enfermedad. Pero cualquiera que salga y se rinda a los babilonios que {{plural_you:los|os}} atacan vivirá. Escapará con vida, y eso será todo lo que se lleve.

fr.L: Celui qui restera dans cette ville mourra par l’épée, par la famine et par la peste ; mais celui qui sortira et passera aux Chaldéens qui vous assiègent vivra, et sa vie sera pour lui un butin.
fr.B: Ceux qui resteront dans cette ville mourront par l’épée, la famine et la peste. Mais ceux qui sortiront pour se rendre aux Chaldéens qui vous assiègent vivront ; ils emporteront leur vie pour seul butin.
fr.R: Celui qui restera dans cette ville mourra à la guerre, de faim ou de maladie. Mais celui qui sortira pour se rendre aux Babyloniens qui vous attaquent restera en vie. Il aura la vie sauve, et ce sera tout ce qu’il aura.

sw.L: Anayekaa katika mji huu atakufa kwa upanga, na kwa njaa, na kwa tauni; lakini anayetoka na kujisalimisha kwa Wakaldayo wanaowazingira ataishi, naye atakuwa na nafsi yake kama nyara.
sw.B: Wanaobaki katika mji huu watakufa kwa upanga, njaa na tauni. Lakini wale wanaotoka na kujisalimisha kwa Wakaldayo wanaowazingira wataishi; wataokoa maisha yao kama nyara yao pekee.
sw.R: Mtu yeyote anayebaki katika mji huu atakufa kwa vita, njaa au magonjwa. Lakini yeyote atakayetoka na kujisalimisha kwa Wababeli wanaowashambulia ataishi. Ataokoka na maisha yake, na hicho ndicho tu atakachopata.

vi.L: Ai ở lại trong thành này sẽ chết vì gươm, vì nạn đói và vì ôn dịch; nhưng ai ra ngoài và đầu hàng người Canh-đê đang vây hãm các ngươi thì sẽ sống, và mạng sống của người ấy sẽ là chiến lợi phẩm của mình.
vi.B: Ai ở lại trong thành này sẽ chết vì gươm đao, nạn đói và dịch bệnh. Nhưng ai ra ngoài đầu hàng người Canh-đê đang vây hãm các ngươi thì sẽ sống; họ sẽ giữ được mạng sống mình như chiến lợi phẩm duy nhất.
vi.R: Ai ở lại trong thành này sẽ chết vì chiến tranh, nạn đói hay bệnh tật. Nhưng ai ra ngoài đầu hàng quân Ba-by-lôn đang tấn công các ngươi thì sẽ sống. Họ sẽ thoát được mạng sống, và đó là tất cả những gì họ có được.

ko.L: 이 성에 머무는 자는 칼과 기근과 전염병으로 죽을 것이다. 그러나 나가서 너희를 포위하고 있는 갈대아 사람들에게 항복하는 자는 살 것이다. 그의 목숨이 그에게 전리품이 될 것이다.
ko.B: 이 성에 머무는 사람은 칼과 기근과 전염병으로 죽을 것이다. 그러나 나가서 너희를 포위하고 있는 갈대아 사람들에게 항복하는 사람은 살 것이다. 그는 목숨만은 전리품처럼 건질 것이다.
ko.R: 이 성에 남아 있는 사람은 전쟁이나 굶주림이나 질병으로 죽을 것이다. 그러나 나가서 너희를 공격하는 바빌로니아 사람들에게 항복하는 사람은 살 것이다. 그는 목숨만은 건질 것이다. 그것이 그가 얻을 전부일 것이다.

pt.L: Quem ficar nesta cidade morrerá pela espada, pela fome e pela peste; mas quem sair e se passar para os caldeus que sitiam vocês viverá, e a sua vida lhe será por despojo.
pt.B: Quem ficar nesta cidade morrerá pela espada, pela fome e pela peste. Mas quem sair e se render aos caldeus que estão cercando vocês viverá; sairá levando a própria vida como único despojo.
pt.R: Quem ficar nesta cidade vai morrer na guerra, de fome ou de doença. Mas quem sair e se render aos babilônios que estão atacando vocês vai viver. Essa pessoa vai escapar com vida, e não vai levar mais nada.

decisions.choice: fall to the Chaldeans: go over to the enemy, surrender
decisions.reason: To "fall to" an army is to desert to it and give oneself up (37:13-14; 38:19; 39:9). To the city's leaders this was treason (38:4).

decisions.choice: his life will be his as plunder: he will escape with nothing but his life
alternatives: his life will be his prize, a gain snatched from disaster
decisions.reason: Plunder is what a soldier carries off from a battle. The one who surrenders will carry off only one thing, his own life, as if it were the spoil of war. The saying returns in 38:2, 39:18 and 45:5. It may instead stress the gain: life itself will be his prize, snatched from the ruin of the city.

decisions.choice: will live: the form read aloud, with the written form giving the same sense
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text has one form of the verb "live" and the margin tells readers to read another, with "and" in front. The meaning is the same either way: the one who surrenders will live.

decisions.choice: surrender as the way of life
decisions.reason: For a people who had trusted that God would never let his city fall (7:4), this was a hard word. The LORD had given the land to Babylon for a time (27:6-8), and submitting to Babylon was now submitting to God's judgment (27:12-13; 38:17-18).

decisions.choice: sword, famine and plague (B); war, famine or disease (R); Babylonians (R)
decisions.reason: The wording settled for Jeremiah. Readable says "or" because each person dies one way.

decisions.choice: those who (B); anyone who ... they (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "he who" means any person, man or woman. Balanced uses the plural, and Readable "anyone" and "they", so no gender setting is needed.

decisions.choice: tendrá su vida por botín (Literal); escaparán con vida como único botín (Balanced); Escapará con vida, y eso será todo lo que se lleve (Readable)
decisions.reason: The saying "his life as plunder" keeps this wording at each level each time it returns (38:2; 39:18; 45:5), as the English note sets.

decisions.choice: "atakuwa na nafsi yake kama nyara" (L); "wataokoa maisha yao kama nyara yao pekee" (B); "Ataokoka na maisha yake, na hicho ndicho tu atakachopata" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording used for "his life as plunder" at each level wherever it returns in Jeremiah (38:2; 39:18; 45:5).

decisions.choice: "sa vie sera pour lui un butin" (L); "ils emporteront leur vie comme seul butin" (B); "il s'échappera avec sa vie, et c'est tout ce qu'il emportera" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of this saying at each level for its returns (38:2; 39:18; 45:5). French "celui qui ... il" is generic, so Readable needs no gender setting.

decisions.choice: "mạng sống ... là chiến lợi phẩm của mình" / "giữ được mạng sống mình như chiến lợi phẩm duy nhất" / "thoát chết, và đó là tất cả"
decisions.reason: The wording settled for "his life as plunder" at each level, to be reused where the saying returns (38:2; 39:18; 45:5).

decisions.choice: "그의 목숨이 그에게 전리품이 될 것이다" (L); "목숨만은 전리품처럼 건질 것이다" (B); "목숨만은 건질 것이다. 그것이 ... 전부일 것이다" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for "his life as plunder" in Jeremiah (21:9; 38:2; 39:18; 45:5): he escapes with his life and nothing more (meaning decision m2).

source.text: כִּ֣י שַׂ֣מְתִּי פָ֠נַי בָּעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֧את לְרָעָ֛ה וְלֹ֥א לְטוֹבָ֖ה נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה בְּיַד־מֶ֤לֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ תִּנָּתֵ֔ן וּשְׂרָפָ֖הּ בָּאֵֽשׁ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For I have set my face against the city this for harm and not for good, declaration of Yahweh; into [the] hand of [the] king of Babylon it will be given, and he will burn it with the fire.

en.L: For I have set {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face against this city for harm and not for good, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; it will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.'"
en.B: For I have set {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face against this city for disaster and not for good, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. It will be handed over to the king of Babylon, and he will burn it down.'"
en.R: I have made up {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} mind to bring disaster on this city, not good, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. It will be handed over to the king of Babylon, and he will burn it to the ground.'"

es.L: Porque he puesto {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro contra esta ciudad para mal y no para bien, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; en mano del rey de Babilonia será entregada, y él la quemará a fuego”».
es.B: Porque he puesto {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro contra esta ciudad para desgracia y no para bien, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Será entregada en manos del rey de Babilonia, y él la incendiará”».
es.R: He decidido traer desgracia sobre esta ciudad, y no bien, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Será entregada al rey de Babilonia, y él la quemará hasta los cimientos”».

fr.L: Car j’ai tourné {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} face contre cette ville pour le mal et non pour le bien, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; elle sera livrée entre les mains du roi de Babylone, et il la brûlera par le feu.” »
fr.B: Car j’ai tourné {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} face contre cette ville, pour son malheur et non pour son bien, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Elle sera livrée au roi de Babylone, et il l’incendiera.” »
fr.R: J’ai pris la décision de faire venir le malheur sur cette ville, et non le bonheur, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Elle sera livrée au roi de Babylone, et il la brûlera complètement.” »

sw.L: Kwa maana nimeuelekeza uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu ya mji huu kwa mabaya wala si kwa mema, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; utatiwa mkononi mwa mfalme wa Babeli, naye atauteketeza kwa moto.'"
sw.B: Kwa maana nimeuelekeza uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi ya mji huu ili kuuletea maafa wala si mema, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Utatiwa mikononi mwa mfalme wa Babeli, naye atauchoma moto.'"
sw.R: Nimeamua kuuletea mji huu maafa, si mema, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Utatiwa mikononi mwa mfalme wa Babeli, naye atauchoma moto mpaka uteketee kabisa.'"

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã để mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nghịch cùng thành này để giáng họa chứ không phải để ban phước, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy; nó sẽ bị phó vào tay vua Ba-by-lôn, và vua ấy sẽ dùng lửa thiêu đốt nó.'"
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã quyết định nghịch cùng thành này để giáng tai họa chứ không phải để ban điều tốt, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Thành sẽ bị phó vào tay vua Ba-by-lôn, và vua ấy sẽ thiêu hủy nó.'"
vi.R: Ta đã quyết định giáng tai họa trên thành này, chứ không ban điều tốt, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Thành sẽ bị phó vào tay vua Ba-by-lôn, và vua ấy sẽ thiêu rụi nó.'"

ko.L: 내가 이 성에 복이 아니라 재앙을 내리려고 내 얼굴을 이 성으로 향했기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 이 성은 바빌론 왕의 손에 넘어갈 것이고, 그는 그것을 불로 태울 것이다.'"
ko.B: 내가 이 성에 복이 아니라 재앙을 내리기로 작정하고 이 성을 마주 보고 있기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 이 성은 바빌론 왕에게 넘어갈 것이고, 그는 이 성을 불태울 것이다.'"
ko.R: 내가 이 성에 좋은 일이 아니라 재앙을 내리기로 마음을 정했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 이 성은 바빌론 왕에게 넘어갈 것이다. 그는 이 성을 불태워 잿더미로 만들 것이다.'"

pt.L: Pois pus o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} rosto contra esta cidade para o mal e não para o bem, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}; na mão do rei da Babilônia ela será entregue, e ele a queimará com fogo.'"
pt.B: Pois voltei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} rosto contra esta cidade para a desgraça, e não para o bem, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Ela será entregue ao rei da Babilônia, e ele a incendiará.'"
pt.R: Eu tomei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} decisão: vou trazer desgraça a esta cidade, e não o bem, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Ela vai ser entregue ao rei da Babilônia, e ele vai queimá-la até não sobrar nada.'"

decisions.choice: set my face against: turn against with fixed purpose
decisions.reason: To set one's face toward something is to be resolved on it; with "against" it means to oppose with full intent (Leviticus 20:3-6; Jeremiah 44:11).

decisions.choice: harm and not good: disaster, not prosperity
decisions.reason: The word for "harm" means trouble or disaster that comes on someone, not moral evil in God. The same pair is used in 39:16 and 44:27.

decisions.choice: the burning of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The Babylonians burned the temple, the palace and the houses of Jerusalem in 586 BC (39:8; 52:13).

decisions.choice: I have made up my mind
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of setting one's face.

decisions.choice: "J'ai pris la décision" (R), with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of setting one's face, as the English "made up my mind"; French says it without a possessive, so there is no span.

decisions.choice: "đã quyết định nghịch cùng" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of setting the face; at Balanced, as at Readable, the picture is put plainly, since Vietnamese "để mặt" has no such sense of fixed purpose.

records.literal_gloss: And to [the] house of [the] king of Judah: hear [the] word of Yahweh.

en.L: And to the house of the king of Judah: \q Hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: To the royal house of Judah: \q Hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: This message is for the family of the king of Judah: \q Listen to what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says.

es.L: Y a la casa del rey de Judá: \q {{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: A la casa real de Judá: \q {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Este mensaje es para la familia del rey de Judá: \q {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et à la maison du roi de Juda : \q Écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: À la maison royale de Juda : \q Écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ce message est pour la famille du roi de Juda : \q Écoutez le message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na kwa nyumba ya mfalme wa Yuda: \q Sikieni neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kwa jamaa ya kifalme ya Yuda: \q Sikilizeni neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Ujumbe huu ni kwa ajili ya jamaa ya mfalme wa Yuda: \q Sikilizeni ujumbe huu kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Và với nhà vua Giu-đa: \q Hãy nghe lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Gửi hoàng tộc Giu-đa: \q Hãy nghe lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Đây là sứ điệp cho gia đình vua Giu-đa: \q Hãy nghe điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 그리고 유다 왕의 집에 [이르는 말씀이다]. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 들어라.
ko.R: 유다 왕의 집안에 주시는 말씀이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀을 들어라.

pt.L: E à casa do rei de Judá: \q Ouçam a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: À casa real de Judá: \q Ouçam a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Esta mensagem é para a família do rei de Judá: \q Escutem o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz.

decisions.choice: a heading: "To the house of the king of Judah" opens a collection of words about the kings
decisions.reason: The words stand like a title, as "Concerning the prophets" does in 23:9. They begin a group of messages to and about Judah's royal house that runs to 23:8, with words about Shallum (22:11), Jehoiakim (22:18) and Coniah (22:24). The small word in front may mean "to" or "concerning".

decisions.choice: the house of the king: the royal family and court
decisions.reason: "House" here is the king's dynasty and household, not the palace building; verse 12 calls it "the house of David".

decisions.choice: a poetic oracle from here to verse 14, with no quotation marks
decisions.reason: The prose speeches end with verse 10. Verses 11-14 are a short oracle set in lines; as in the poetry of the prophets, God's words take no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: the royal house (B); the family of the king (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "the house of the king" means.

decisions.choice: "Hãy nghe lời của CHÚA" / "Hãy nghe lời CHÚA" / "Hãy nghe điều CHÚA phán"
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for "hear the word of the LORD" (2 Kings 20:16), used at each level through these chapters.

decisions.choice: "[이르는 말씀이다]" (L); "[주시는 말씀이다]" (B)
decisions.reason: The heading is a bare phrase, "To the house of the king of Judah" (meaning decision m1). Korean cannot leave "~에" hanging before a new line, so it supplies "the word" in brackets at Literal and Balanced; Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 들어라" (L, B); "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀을 들어라" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for "hear the word of the LORD".

source.text: בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֗ד כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה דִּ֤ינוּ לַבֹּ֨קֶר֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וְהַצִּ֥ילוּ גָז֖וּל מִיַּ֣ד עוֹשֵׁ֑ק פֶּן־תֵּצֵ֨א כָאֵ֜שׁ חֲמָתִ֗י וּבָעֲרָה֙ וְאֵ֣ין מְכַבֶּ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: House of David, thus says Yahweh: judge in the morning justice, and deliver [the] robbed from [the] hand of [the] oppressor, lest go out like the fire my fury and burn and there is none quenching, because of [the] evil of your deeds.

en.L: House of David, thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: \q Judge justice in the morning, \q and rescue the robbed from the hand of the oppressor, \q lest {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} fury go out like fire and burn with none to quench [it], \q because of the evil of your deeds.
en.B: House of David, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: \q Give fair judgment every morning, \q and rescue the one who has been robbed from the power of the oppressor. \q Otherwise {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} fury will break out like fire and burn with no one to put it out, \q because of your evil deeds.
en.R: Family of David, this is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: \q Every morning, judge people fairly. \q Save people who have been robbed from those who mistreat them. \q If you do not, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger will blaze up like a fire. It will burn, and no one will be able to put it out, \q because of the evil things you have done.

es.L: Casa de David, así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} justicia por la mañana, \q y {{plural_you:libren|librad}} al despojado de mano del opresor, \q no sea que {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor salga como fuego y arda sin que haya quien [lo] apague, \q por la maldad de {{plural_you:sus obras|vuestras obras}}.
es.B: Casa de David, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: \q {{plural_you:Juzguen|Juzgad}} con justicia cada mañana, \q y {{plural_you:libren|librad}} al que ha sido despojado del poder del opresor. \q Si no, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor estallará como fuego y arderá sin que nadie lo pueda apagar, \q por {{plural_you:sus malas obras|vuestras malas obras}}.
es.R: Familia de David, esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q Cada mañana, {{plural_you:juzguen|juzgad}} a la gente con justicia. \q {{plural_you:Salven|Salvad}} a los que han sido robados de los que los maltratan. \q Si no lo {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}}, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira se encenderá como un fuego. Arderá, y nadie podrá apagarla, \q por las maldades que {{plural_you:ustedes han|vosotros habéis}} hecho.

fr.L: Maison de David, ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Jugez avec droiture dès le matin, \q et délivrez celui qu’on dépouille de la main de l’oppresseur, \q de peur que {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur ne sorte comme un feu et ne brûle sans que personne [l’]éteigne, \q à cause de la méchanceté de vos actions.
fr.B: Maison de David, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : \q Rendez la justice chaque matin, \q et délivrez celui qu’on a dépouillé du pouvoir de l’oppresseur. \q Sinon, {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur éclatera comme un feu et brûlera sans que personne puisse l’éteindre, \q à cause de vos actions mauvaises.
fr.R: Famille de David, voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Chaque matin, jugez les gens avec justice. \q Sauvez ceux qu’on a volés de ceux qui les maltraitent. \q Si vous ne le faites pas, {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère s’enflammera comme un feu. Elle brûlera, et personne ne pourra l’éteindre, \q à cause du mal que vous avez fait.

sw.L: Nyumba ya Daudi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: \q Hukumuni hukumu ya haki asubuhi, \q mkamwokoe aliyenyang'anywa kutoka mkononi mwa mdhalimu, \q ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} isije ikatoka kama moto na kuwaka bila mtu wa kuuzima, \q kwa sababu ya uovu wa matendo yenu.
sw.B: Nyumba ya Daudi, hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: \q Toeni hukumu ya haki kila asubuhi, \q mkamwokoe aliyenyang'anywa kutoka katika nguvu za mdhalimu. \q La sivyo ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itazuka kama moto na kuwaka bila mtu wa kuizima, \q kwa sababu ya matendo yenu maovu.
sw.R: Jamaa ya Daudi, hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: \q Kila asubuhi waamueni watu kwa haki. \q Waokoeni walionyang'anywa mali zao kutoka kwa wale wanaowaonea. \q Msipofanya hivyo, hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itawaka kama moto. Itawaka, na hakuna atakayeweza kuizima, \q kwa sababu ya maovu mliyoyatenda.

vi.L: Hỡi nhà Đa-vít, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: \q Mỗi buổi sáng hãy xét xử cho công minh, \q và giải cứu người bị cướp khỏi tay kẻ áp bức, \q kẻo cơn thịnh nộ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bùng ra như lửa và cháy mà không ai dập tắt được, \q vì những việc làm gian ác của các ngươi.
vi.B: Hỡi nhà Đa-vít, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: \q Mỗi buổi sáng hãy xét xử công minh, \q hãy giải cứu người bị cướp bóc khỏi quyền lực kẻ áp bức. \q Nếu không, cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bùng lên như lửa, cháy mãi không ai dập tắt nổi, \q vì những việc gian ác của các ngươi.
vi.R: Hỡi dòng họ Đa-vít, đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: \q Mỗi buổi sáng, hãy xét xử cho công bằng. \q Hãy cứu những người bị cướp khỏi tay kẻ áp bức họ. \q Nếu các ngươi không làm vậy, cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bùng cháy như lửa. Lửa sẽ cháy mãi, không ai dập tắt được, \q vì những điều gian ác các ngươi đã làm.

ko.L: 다윗의 집아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. \q 아침마다 공의로 재판하고, \q 강탈당한 자를 억압하는 자의 손에서 건져 내어라. \q 그렇지 않으면 너희의 악한 행실 때문에 \q 내 분노가 불같이 일어나 타올라도 끌 자가 없을 것이다.
ko.B: 다윗의 집아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. \q 아침마다 공정하게 재판하고, \q 강탈당한 사람을 억압하는 자의 손에서 구해 내어라. \q 그렇지 않으면 너희의 악한 행실 때문에 \q 내 분노가 불같이 터져 나와 타오르고, 아무도 끄지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 다윗의 집안아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. \q 아침마다 사람들을 공정하게 재판하여라. \q 강탈당한 사람을 괴롭히는 자들에게서 구해 주어라. \q 그렇게 하지 않으면 너희가 저지른 악한 일 때문에 \q 내 분노가 불처럼 타오를 것이다. 아무도 그 불을 끄지 못할 것이다.

pt.L: Casa de Davi, assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q Julguem com justiça pela manhã \q e livrem o roubado da mão do opressor, \q para que o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} furor não saia como fogo e queime sem haver quem [o] apague, \q por causa da maldade das ações de vocês.
pt.B: Casa de Davi, assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q Façam julgamentos justos todas as manhãs \q e livrem quem foi roubado do poder do opressor. \q Do contrário, o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} furor vai irromper como fogo e queimar, sem que ninguém possa apagá-lo, \q por causa das más ações de vocês.
pt.R: Família de Davi, é isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: \q Todas as manhãs, julguem as pessoas com justiça. \q Salvem as pessoas que foram roubadas das mãos de quem as maltrata. \q Se não fizerem isso, a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira vai se acender como fogo. Vai queimar, e ninguém vai conseguir apagá-la, \q por causa das coisas más que vocês fizeram.

decisions.choice: judge justice in the morning: hear cases fairly, every day and without delay
decisions.reason: The king was the highest judge in the land, and cases were heard in the morning at the city gate or the palace (2 Samuel 15:2; Psalm 101:8). "In the morning" may mean every morning, or promptly, as the first business of the day.

decisions.choice: rescue the robbed from the oppressor: protect the weak against the strong
decisions.reason: The robbed and the oppressor are the victim and the one who cheats or exploits him. Defending the powerless was the king's first duty (22:3, 15-16; Psalm 72:1-4).

decisions.choice: lest my fury go out like fire ... because of the evil of your deeds: the warning of 4:4, repeated
decisions.reason: The last four lines repeat almost word for word the end of 4:4, spoken there to the people of Judah and Jerusalem. Now the warning is aimed at the king's house.

decisions.choice: your deeds: the form read aloud
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text has "their deeds"; the margin tells readers to read "your deeds", which fits the address to the house of David and matches 4:4. The form read aloud is followed.

decisions.choice: every morning (B, R); Family of David (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable take "in the morning" as a daily duty, and Readable says "family" for the royal house.

decisions.choice: If you do not
decisions.reason: Readable turns "lest" into a plain condition.

decisions.choice: "because of the evil of your deeds" placed on the line before the fire
alternatives: the cause after the fire, as the Hebrew
decisions.reason: Korean puts a cause before what it causes; the fire still ends the verse, so the lines keep the Hebrew's two halves.

source.text: הִנְנִ֨י אֵלַ֜יִךְ יֹשֶׁ֧בֶת הָעֵ֛מֶק צ֥וּר הַמִּישֹׁ֖ר נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה הָאֹֽמְרִים֙ מִֽי־יֵחַ֣ת עָלֵ֔ינוּ וּמִ֥י יָב֖וֹא בִּמְעוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look I [am] against you, inhabitant of the valley, rock of the plain, declaration of Yahweh, the [ones] saying: Who will come down against us, and who will enter into our dwellings?

en.L: Look, I am against you, inhabitant of the valley, rock of the plain, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q you who say, "Who will come down against us, \q and who will enter our dwellings?"
en.B: Look, I am against you, you who sit above the valley, rock on the plain, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q you who say, "Who can come down on us? \q Who can break into our homes?"
en.R: Listen, I am against you, Jerusalem, sitting on your rock above the valley and the plain, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q You say, "No one can attack us. \q No one can get into our safe homes."

es.L: He aquí, yo estoy contra ti, habitante del valle, roca de la llanura, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q los que dicen: «¿Quién bajará contra nosotros, \q y quién entrará en nuestras moradas?».
es.B: Yo estoy contra ti, tú que estás sobre el valle, roca de la llanura, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q a los que dicen: «¿Quién podrá bajar contra nosotros? \q ¿Quién entrará en nuestras casas?».
es.R: Escucha, Jerusalén, yo estoy contra ti, que estás sentada en tu roca, sobre el valle y la llanura, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Tú dices: «Nadie puede atacarnos. \q Nadie puede entrar en nuestras casas seguras».

fr.L: Voici, je suis contre toi, habitante de la vallée, rocher de la plaine, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q vous qui dites : « Qui descendra contre nous, \q et qui entrera dans nos demeures ? »
fr.B: Me voici contre toi, toi qui sièges au-dessus de la vallée, rocher dans la plaine, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q vous qui dites : « Qui pourrait descendre contre nous ? \q Qui pourrait pénétrer dans nos demeures ? »
fr.R: Écoute, Jérusalem, je suis contre toi, toi qui es installée sur ton rocher au-dessus de la vallée et de la plaine, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Vous dites : « Personne ne peut nous attaquer. \q Personne ne peut entrer dans nos maisons bien protégées. »

sw.L: Tazama, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni juu yako, ewe ukaaye bondeni, mwamba wa uwandani, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q ninyi msemao, "Ni nani atakayeshuka juu yetu, \q na ni nani atakayeingia makaoni mwetu?"
sw.B: Tazama, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni dhidi yako, wewe uketiye juu ya bonde, mwamba ulio uwandani, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q ninyi msemao, "Ni nani awezaye kushuka kutushambulia? \q Ni nani awezaye kuvunja na kuingia nyumbani mwetu?"
sw.R: Sikiliza, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni dhidi yako, Yerusalemu, wewe uliyeketi juu ya mwamba wako juu ya bonde na uwanda, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Mnasema, "Hakuna awezaye kutushambulia. \q Hakuna awezaye kuingia katika makao yetu salama."

vi.L: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nghịch cùng ngươi, hỡi kẻ ở trong thung lũng, hỡi vầng đá giữa đồng bằng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q các ngươi là những kẻ nói: "Ai sẽ xuống đánh chúng ta, \q và ai sẽ vào được nơi ở của chúng ta?"
vi.B: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nghịch cùng ngươi, hỡi kẻ ngự trên thung lũng, hỡi vầng đá giữa đồng bằng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q các ngươi là những kẻ nói: "Ai dám xuống đánh chúng ta? \q Ai vào được nhà cửa chúng ta?"
vi.R: Hỡi Giê-ru-sa-lem, ngươi ngồi trên vầng đá cao trên thung lũng và đồng bằng. Hãy nghe đây, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nghịch cùng ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. \q Các ngươi nói: "Không ai tấn công được chúng ta. \q Không ai vào được nhà cửa an toàn của chúng ta."

ko.L: 보아라, 골짜기에 사는 자, 평지의 바위야, 내가 너를 치겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. \q "누가 우리를 치러 내려오겠으며, \q 누가 우리의 거처에 들어오겠느냐?" 하고 말하는 너희를 치겠다.
ko.B: 보아라, 골짜기 위에 앉은 자, 평지에 솟은 바위야, 내가 너를 치겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q "누가 우리를 치러 내려올 수 있겠느냐? \q 누가 우리 집에 쳐들어올 수 있겠느냐?" 하고 말하는 너희를 치겠다.
ko.R: 예루살렘아, 골짜기와 평지 위 바위에 앉아 있는 너를 내가 치겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 너희는 말한다. "아무도 우리를 공격하지 못한다. \q 아무도 우리의 안전한 집에 들어오지 못한다."

pt.L: Eis que eu [estou] contra ti, moradora do vale, rocha da planície, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q os que dizem: "Quem descerá contra nós, \q e quem entrará nas nossas moradas?"
pt.B: Vê: eu estou contra ti, que estás assentada acima do vale, rocha sobre a planície, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q contra vocês que dizem: "Quem pode descer sobre nós? \q Quem pode invadir as nossas casas?"
pt.R: Escuta, Jerusalém: eu estou contra ti, sentada na tua rocha, acima do vale e da planície, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. \q Vocês dizem: "Ninguém pode nos atacar. \q Ninguém pode entrar nas nossas casas seguras."

decisions.choice: "you" is a woman: the city of Jerusalem, home of the royal house
decisions.reason: The "you" and "inhabitant" are feminine. The prophets often speak to a city as a woman (Isaiah 1:21). The city is addressed together with the king's house of verses 11-12; the speakers who boast are plural.

decisions.choice: inhabitant of the valley, rock of the plain: Jerusalem sitting on its rocky height above the valleys
alternatives: a place on a plateau outside Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Jerusalem stood on a ridge with deep valleys on three sides. The word for "inhabitant" can also mean one who sits enthroned, so the city may be pictured as sitting high over the valley like a fortress on a rock, sure no one can reach her. Others take the words as a reference to the palace, or to a place outside Jerusalem; the word for "plain" usually means level tableland (48:8, 21). The exact picture is uncertain.

decisions.choice: our dwellings: hidden, safe homes, like the dens of animals
decisions.reason: The word is used of the lairs of wild animals (Nahum 2:13; Psalm 104:22) and of a dwelling place. The people think their homes are as safe as a lion's den in the rocks.

decisions.choice: "Who will come down against us?": the city's false confidence
decisions.reason: The questions expect the answer "No one". The people trust their position, as they trusted the temple (7:4). The LORD's answer is that he himself is against them.

decisions.choice: Jerusalem; No one can attack us
decisions.reason: Readable names the city the feminine "you" means, and turns the boasting questions into the statements they imply.

decisions.choice: you who sit above the valley
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the sense of the city sitting high over the valley; Literal keeps "inhabitant of the valley".

decisions.choice: ti, habitante (feminine singular address)
decisions.reason: The "you" is a woman, the city of Jerusalem (meaning decision m1), so it is "tú" in Spanish; the words that follow are her people's, quoted with « ».

decisions.choice: "habitante" (L), "installée" (R): the feminine "you"
decisions.reason: French can show what the Hebrew shows: the "you" is a woman, the city of Jerusalem (meaning decision m1). The people of the city then speak in the plural, "vous qui dites", as the Hebrew plural does.

decisions.choice: "ngươi" for the city, "các ngươi" for its people
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks to Jerusalem as a woman and then quotes its people; Vietnamese has no gender in "ngươi", so the city is "ngươi" and the speakers "các ngươi", which keeps the shift of the Hebrew without inventing a gendered word.

decisions.choice: "예루살렘아"
decisions.reason: The one addressed is the city (meaning decision m1); Readable names it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: ti, moradora (the city as a woman); os que dizem, vocês (its people)
decisions.reason: The "you" and "inhabitant" are feminine singular (m1): the LORD speaks to Jerusalem as a woman, so "tu" and "moradora", as he speaks to a city or nation as one throughout the book. "Those who say" is plural, the people of the city, and Portuguese follows the change with "os que dizem" (L) and "vocês" (B, R).

en.L: And I will punish you according to the fruit of your deeds, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q and I will kindle a fire in her forest, \q and it will devour all that is around her.

pt.B: Vou castigar vocês conforme o que as suas ações merecem, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. \q Porei fogo na floresta dela, \q e ele consumirá tudo o que está ao seu redor.
pt.R: Vou castigar vocês pelo que fizeram, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. \q Vou pôr fogo na floresta dela, \q e o fogo vai queimar tudo o que está em volta dela.

decisions.choice: visit on you: punish, call you to account
decisions.reason: The verb means to attend to someone; with "on" it means to come and deal with wrongdoing. The "you" is plural, the royal house and the people.

decisions.choice: the fruit of your deeds: what your actions have earned
decisions.reason: Deeds bear fruit like a tree; the punishment is the harvest of what they have done (17:10; 32:19).

decisions.choice: her forest: perhaps the cedar buildings of the royal palace
alternatives: a picture of fire in a forest
decisions.reason: "Her" is the city of verse 13. The forest may be the palace itself: Solomon's great hall was called "the House of the Forest of Lebanon" for its cedar pillars (1 Kings 7:2), and 22:6-7, 23 speak of the king's house as Lebanon with its cedars cut down. It may also be a plain picture of a fire spreading through a wood to everything nearby.

decisions.choice: the change from "you" to "her"
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks to the people ("you") and then about the city ("her"). Such changes of person are common in prophetic poetry.

decisions.choice: for what you have done
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of "the fruit of your deeds".

decisions.choice: "그 숲", "그 사방" for "her forest", "around her"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from "you" to "her" (meaning decision m4). Korean marks the shift with "그" rather than a feminine pronoun, which would sound foreign; Readable says "그 성" so the city is clear.

decisions.choice: farei ... prestarem contas
decisions.reason: As Isaiah 13:11's Portuguese: "visitar" in this sense is no longer understood, so Literal says "prestar contas", which keeps the picture of God coming to deal with the wrong (m1); Balanced and Readable say "castigar", as the English says "punish".
